symbols.name: GaiaEffectLoop
symbols.note: sub_016794: the endless loop of GaiaEffect: finds the first free sprite slot (Y word 0) from slot 16, builds the rock sprites (GaiaInitRocks), then per iteration GaiaShakeVSRAM, GaiaMoveRocks, FlushDMACopyQueue and GaiaCheckDone (which pops its own return address to leave). Nothing else of the game runs meanwhile = the freeze. tools/patch_gaia.py re-implements it per game pass (option 'Live Gaia Effect')

symbols.name: GaiaInitRocks
symbols.note: sub_0167D6: writes 41 rock sprites into the sprite table from a0 (Y = random 0..$DF - $60, size byte $0F = 4x4 tiles, tile word $C78C / $C79C / $C7AC in turn, X = random 0..$13F + $80); the LAST entry gets Y = 1 and link $10 and is the cycle timer of the effect

symbols.name: GaiaShakeVSRAM
symbols.note: sub_016848: adds d4 (+4, then -4 ...) to both VSRAM words and queues the update = the screen shakes 4 px

symbols.name: GaiaMoveRocks

symbols.name: g_RightArrowCursorState
symbols.note: misnamed in the disassembly: bit 0 = the dialogue text box is open (set by LoadTextboxGraphics $028F7E, cleared by ClearTextbox -> SetUpTextDisplay), bit 1 = no-money effect running (NoMoneyEffect / RestoreFromNoMoneyEffect) [verified 2026-10-20 by reading the code, own renderer text box]

symbols.name: g_HUD_Row1
symbols.note: window plane tilemap row 0 in RAM (64 words, mirror of VRAM $F000); HUD = rows 0..2 ($FF1C00 / $FF1C80 / $FF1D00 = g_HUD_Row1..3) [lordmir ram.inc, equal to VRAM measured 2026-10-18]

symbols.name: g_HUD_Row2
symbols.note: window plane tilemap row 1 (HUD hearts, digits) [lordmir ram.inc]

symbols.name: g_HUD_Row3
symbols.note: window plane tilemap row 2 [lordmir ram.inc]

symbols.name: g_InventoryTilemap
symbols.note: window plane tile map of the inventory screen (64 words per row, DMA'd to VRAM $F180); the visible 36 x 17 tile list starts at $FF1E04 (+$84), row stride $80 bytes

symbols.name: g_InventoryListTiles
symbols.note: 36 columns x 17 rows of the big box's list area (tile = $A000 | CHR code, one 8x8 tile per character, like item names in sub_D5E4); tools/patch_options.py draws the options page here

symbols.name: g_TextBoxLine1
symbols.note: window plane tilemap row 20 (text box top); g_TextBoxLine1..8 = rows 20..27, stride $80, equal to VRAM $F000 + $80 * row [lordmir ram.inc, measured 2026-10-18]

symbols.name: g_Buffer
symbols.note: general work buffer; with the Start menu open it holds the Use list tile map (g_Buffer+$84, row stride $48 = 36 cells, 4 tile rows per item row, InventoryMenu_DrawList copies the visible rows to g_InventoryTilemap) and, with more than ~11 item rows, runs on into g_ScreenBuffer ($FF3900); other screens use it for tile maps (title, file select, credits font) [from the disassembly ram.inc; overflow into $FF3900 found 2026-10-21 (Item Info garbage icons)]

symbols.name: g_InventoryMenuCursorRow
symbols.note: word, cursor pixel row of the Use tab item grid (>> 2 = row); with $FF2C0A (column) and $FF2C0C (scroll) it gives the item under the cursor (InventoryMenu_UseItem $00DB28)

symbols.name: g_InventoryMenuCursorCol
symbols.note: word, cursor column of the Use tab item grid (0 / 1)

symbols.name: g_InventoryMenuScroll
symbols.note: word, scroll offset (rows) of the Use tab item grid

symbols.name: g_EquipMenuCursorCol
symbols.note: column 0..4 of the cursor in the Equip grid (loop at $00EAD4); item id = ROM EquipInventoryLayout $00ECE0 + row * 5 + column (bit 7 = nothing)

symbols.name: g_EquipMenuCursorRow
symbols.note: row 0..3 (sword, armour, boots, ring) of the cursor in the Equip grid

symbols.name: g_InventoryMenuItems
symbols.note: byte list of the item ids shown in the Start menu Use tab (filled by DrawItemList_Populate from InventoryItems $00D55C); index = list offset ($FF2C0A) + 2 * (row + scroll)

symbols.name: g_VdpQueueBuffer
symbols.note: VDP write queue buffer: word VDP addr + long (two nametable entries) per entry

symbols.name: Player (Nigel) struct
symbols.note: +00 X, +01 Y (bytes, tile units); position history words from +0x14; entity structs follow from $FF5480, 0x80 bytes each

symbols.name: Player_GroundHeight
symbols.note: entity +22: byte 0 of the height map cell under the entity (low nibble = floor height in 16 unit steps, bit 5 / 6 = blocked for NPCs / everybody); measured 2026-10-17: low nibble equals the cell's in 3760 of 3814 world frames

symbols.name: Player_GroundType
symbols.note: entity +23: byte 1 of the height map cell under the entity = floor type (index into the jump table of ProcessFloorType $00603C: 1-4 doors, 5 stairs, 6 door, 7 pit, 8 warp pad, 0B / 0C ladders, 0E counter, 0F elevator, 10 spikes, 11-18 signs, 19 swamp, 26 / 27 locked doors, 28 Nole staircase, 29 lava, 2A-2D ice, 2E Goddess statue); measured 2026-10-17: equals the cell byte in 3753 of 3814 world frames

symbols.name: PlayerSupportingEntity
symbols.note: entity struct +30 of the player: offset from $FF5400 of the entity Nigel stands on (slot * $80), -1 = none; set by UpdateSupportingEntities $0024F4, read by HandlePlayerLinkedEntity $0017EE / SyncPlayerHeightWithLinkedEntity $001858. For an object on a platform the object has its own +30 = platform slot, but NO move flags of its own (+9 = 0, +2D = 0): the original does not carry Nigel then (fix: patch_carry.py)

symbols.name: Player_CurrentHealth
symbols.note: current health (word, 1/256 hearts steps: the HUD shows (value + $100) >> 8) [names from the lordmir disassembly ram.inc, used by the HUD port 2026-10-20]

symbols.name: Player_MaxHealth
symbols.note: maximum health (word, same scale as Player_CurrentHealth) [names from the lordmir disassembly ram.inc, used by the HUD port 2026-10-20]

symbols.name: EntitySlot_1
symbols.note: first sprite/NPC slot after the player; slots are 0x80 bytes and REUSED (the same address holds different objects over time); fields: +00/+01 tile X/Y (inferred), +03 sub-tile counter (steps of 2), +04 flag byte (0x80 cleared when the walk direction reverses, inferred), +0F/+11 screen x/y

symbols.name: EntitySlot_5 (observed: Massan village chicken)
symbols.note: observation only: in replay massan.txt after leaving the church (frames 646-840) this slot holds the fast-moving chicken; not a fixed variable

symbols.name: EntitySlot_10 (observed: Massan village dog)
symbols.note: observation only: slot visible for ~44 frames right after leaving the church, moves fast and leaves the screen

symbols.name: g_BlockTileTable
symbols.note: block -> 4 tile pairs table used by BlockToTiles

symbols.name: g_MapForeground
symbols.note: room map: 16-bit block indices, 148 bytes (74 blocks) per row

symbols.name: g_MapBackground
symbols.note: background layer of the map, $2AC8 bytes behind the foreground

symbols.name: g_HeightMap
symbols.note: height map, 148 bytes per row, $2AC8 bytes; cleared by GetTilemap on room load
